title: [Bug]: rg --pre and tree -o are classified read-only, so the Bash tool auto-allows running a program and writing a file
body:
### Background

`BashCommandParser._is_single_command_read_only` treats any command that starts with an entry of `READ_ONLY_COMMANDS` plus a space as read-only. `rg` and `tree` are in that list, but t…
